title: bug: SessionManager with 'message' strategy does not persist state (like 'interrupt')
body:
## Bug Report

**SDK Version:** v1.0.0-rc.4+

## Description

When `SessionManager` is configured with `saveLatestOn: 'message'`, interrupt state is not persisted to the snapshot. If the process shuts down between an interrupt and the user's resume, the interrupt state is lost and the agent cannot resume.

With the default `saveLatestOn: 'invocation'` strategy, this works correctly because `_onAfterAgentInvocation` saves a snapshot after every invocation — including interrupted ones. But with `'message'`, snapshots only fire on `MessageAddedEvent` and guardrail redactions. When an interrupt occurs mid-tool-execution, no message is added to the conversation, so no snapshot is taken.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Configure `SessionManager` with `saveLatestOn: 'message'` and a persistent `SnapshotStorage`
2. Add a hook or tool that calls `interrupt()`
3. Invoke the agent — it returns with `stopReason: 'interrupt'`
4. Restart the process and restore the session
5. Attempt to resume with interrupt responses

**Expected:** The interrupt state is restored and the agent resumes correctly.
**Actual:** The interrupt state was never persisted. The agent cannot find the interrupt IDs and throws.

## Root Cause

In `session-manager.ts`, `_onAfterAgentInvocation` only saves when the strategy is `'invocation'`:

```typescript
private async _onAfterAgentInvocation(event: AfterInvocationEvent): Promise<void> {
  if (this._saveLatestOn === 'invocation') {
    await this.saveSnapshot({ target: event.agent, isLatest: true })
  }
  // ...
}
```

The `'message'` strategy never hooks into `AfterInvocationEvent` for saving, so any state that changes without a `MessageAddedEvent` (like interrupt state) is not captured.

## Suggested Fix

Always save a snapshot on `AfterInvocationEvent` regardless of strategy. This matches the Python SDK behavior where session state is always persisted on `AfterInvocationEvent`.

This is broader than interrupts — any agent state that changes during an invocation without producing a new message would have the same gap with the `'message'` strategy.

----

> If someone sets the snapshotting strategy to "message", I think we might end up missing interrupt state snapshotting if the user immediately shuts down the process after invocation ([src](https://github.com/strands-agents/sdk-typescript/blob/main/strands-ts/src/session/session-manager.ts#L205)). In Python, we always session persist on AfterInvocationEvent ([src](https://github.com/strands-agents/sdk-python/blob/main/src/strands/session/session_manager.py#L52)).
> 
> This concern might actually go beyond interrupts. We should probably always snapshot on after invocation event. Users can workaround this for now by setting a snapshotTrigger callback if their latest strategy is "message".

_Originally posted by @pgrayy in https://github.com/strands-agents/sdk-typescript/pull/784#discussion_r3150251644_

       expect(snapshot).not.toBeNull()
     })
 
+    it('saves snapshot_latest when saveLatestOn is message', async () => {
+      sessionManager = new SessionManager({
+        sessionId: 'test-session',
+        storage: { snapshot: storage },

+      })
+
+      await initPluginAndInvokeHook(sessionManager, new AfterInvocationEvent(createMockEvent(mockAgent)))
+
+      const snapshot = await storage.loadSnapshot({
+        location: { sessionId: 'test-session', scope: 'agent', scopeId: 'test-agent' },
+      })
+      expect(snapshot).not.toBeNull()
+    })
+

diff --git a/strands-ts/src/session/session-manager.ts b/strands-ts/src/session/session-manager.ts
index f32cc6f33d..9ba332a8f7 100644
--- a/strands-ts/src/session/session-manager.ts
+++ b/strands-ts/src/session/session-manager.ts
@@ -36,7 +36,8 @@ import type { Swarm } from '../multiagent/swarm.js'
  *
  * `SaveLatestStrategy` controls how frequently `snapshot_latest` is updated:
  * - `'invocation'`: after every agent invocation completes (default; balances durability and I/O)
- * - `'message'`: after every message added (most durable, highest I/O)
+ * - `'message'`: after every message added and when an invocation completes
+ *   (most durable, highest I/O)
  * - `'trigger'`: only when a `snapshotTrigger` fires (or manually via `saveSnapshot`)
  *
  * Under `'invocation'` and `'message'`, guardrail redactions are persisted immediately so
@@ -245,9 +246,9 @@ export class SessionManager implements Plugin, MultiAgentPlugin {
     }
   }
 
-  /** Saves latest on invocation and fires the snapshot trigger if configured. */
+  /** Saves latest for auto-save strategies and fires the snapshot trigger if configured. */
   private async _onAfterAgentInvocation(event: AfterInvocationEvent): Promise<void> {
-    if (this._saveLatestOn === 'invocation') {
+    if (this._saveLatestOn !== 'trigger') {
       await this.saveSnapshot({ target: event.agent, isLatest: true })
     }
